## Research software

- **Koska D** (2026). [**funbootband: Simultaneous Confidence and Prediction Bands for Functional Data**](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=funbootband). R package, CRAN, version 0.3.0. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.32614/CRAN.package.funbootband).

- **Koska D**. [**effort2compress**](https://github.com/koda86/effort2compress). R implementation of the effort-to-compress (ETC) complexity measure introduced by Nagaraj et al. (2013). Research code, GitHub.

- **Koska D**. [**DupliCheck**](https://github.com/koda86/DupliCheck). R package for identifying duplicate bibliographic records using titles, authors, and DOIs. GitHub.
